BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.src = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.dst = f0.id)) AND (e1.arch_type = $2 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $3 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)) AND (n1.root_id = CAST($4 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($5 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($4 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
